title: Tall whites' gated compound on Orcas, reached by an unmarked black helicopter

tellings.quote: And he goes they have a compound on the Orcus Island.

plain: A guest named Brent says a friend on Orcas Island told him that the Tall Whites, tall pale beings some people say live among us, have a gated compound on the island. According to the friend, an unmarked black helicopter flies in to it every couple of months. If true, it would mean these beings have a hidden home with official help.
